text: The rogan josh was heavenly and the naan came out piping hot.
Honestly the curry had zero salt, felt like eating boiled vegetables.
Our host Meera remembered our anniversary and surprised us with a candle on the dessert.
The guy at the counter literally rolled his eyes when I asked for the menu.
Sat there for 50 mins before anyone took our order.
Rs 450 for a tiny bowl of dal? Daylight robbery.
Worth every rupee, the lunch combo is a steal.
The floor near the buffet was greasy and the napkins were stained.
Swiggy order reached in 20 minutes and everything was sealed properly.
Rider called me five times, couldn't find the address, and the gravy had spilled everywhere.
Gorgeous rooftop with fairy lights, perfect for a sunset dinner.
Music was blasting so we had to shout across the table.
The QR menu wouldn't load and the payment link expired twice.
There was a piece of plastic in my paneer and the manager just shrugged.
Spent the whole night vomiting after the prawns, ended up at the clinic.
Saw a rat running behind the counter while we were eating.
Card got charged twice and nobody is answering the phone.
Mast khana, staff bhi bahut helpful tha, zaroor aana.
Order aane mein ek ghanta laga aur khana thanda tha.
Biryani was decent but nothing special for the hype.
Food was lip-smacking but the server kept forgetting our drinks.
They brought chicken when I clearly ordered veg, as a vegetarian this is unacceptable.
Super prompt service, refills came without asking.
Booked a table for 8pm, got seated at 9:15.
Desserts were divine, gulab jamun melted in the mouth.
Restroom had no water and smelled awful.
The bouncer at the door was abusive towards my friend because of how she was dressed.
Packaging was eco-friendly and kept the food warm, loved it.
Website showed the outlet open but it was shut when we arrived.
Cozy seating, soft lighting, and the playlist was on point.
Mutton was chewy and overcooked, and the portion was half of last time.
Bill had items we never ordered, had to argue to get them removed.
Staff were warm and the kids menu was a nice touch.
Quick in and out for lunch, no delays at all.
My delivery never showed up but the app marked it delivered.
Found a dead fly in the raita.
Reasonably priced for such a central location.
Tables wiped right in front of us, very hygienic setup.
Will be filing a complaint with the consumer forum over this treatment.
Average place, nothing to write home about.
